title: PC-CROP Federal Accounting — integration command and retry contract
purpose: Implement the provider-neutral external-command semantics from sections 55-57 without creating a competing persistence store: exact idempotency/correlation/revision/attempt envelope, payload-hash verification, optimistic stale detection, retry classification, bounded exponential backoff with jitter and explicit provider/tenant partition keys for future fair queues.
boundaries: No new IntegrationJob/Outbox/Inbox persistence is created; existing durable stores must be extended later rather than duplicated.
The command envelope carries idempotency_key, correlation_id, organization_id, connection_id, external_id, payload_hash, revision and attempt.
Business rejection is never automatically retried.
Ambiguous/unknown external result requires reconciliation before retry.
Only classified transient transport/provider failures may be automatically retried.
Optimistic revision mismatch is STALE and maps to 409 semantics, not a retryable provider outage.
Payload hash mismatch is a security/integrity failure and not retryable.
No apps/web, packages, lockfile, Prisma, auth, provider credential, banking, FGIS, hosting or production mutation.
Merge and green CI are not production acceptance.
